profiles.label: Ovomorph egg

requiredAnchors.label: Tall asymmetrical ovoid
requiredAnchors.requirement: A tall leathery ovoid broadens near its rooted base and narrows toward the crown rather than resembling a bird egg.

requiredAnchors.label: Four crown lobes
requiredAnchors.requirement: Four thick fleshy lobes meet at a cross-shaped crown seam and can open without reading as flower petals.

requiredAnchors.label: Leathery veined wall
requiredAnchors.requirement: Tough folded walls carry subtle vascular life and damp organic translucency without reptile scales.

requiredAnchors.label: Parasite-sized cavity
requiredAnchors.requirement: The opening and body volume plausibly contain a folded facehugger and stand roughly torso-high beside a person.

promptDirectives: Show all four crown lobes and the living wall in a newly composed nest view.

profiles.label: Big Chap adult phenotype

requiredAnchors.label: Smooth translucent cranial shell
requiredAnchors.requirement: One long smooth semi-translucent cranial shell reveals restrained underlying structure and never becomes a ridged warrior crown.

requiredAnchors.label: Extremely tall lean frame
requiredAnchors.requirement: Narrow waist, long arms and legs, high shoulders and restrained mass create an unnaturally tall stalking outline.

requiredAnchors.label: Four dorsal tubes and central spine
requiredAnchors.requirement: Four long dorsal tubes frame a central rear spine with clean, anatomically rooted spacing.

forbiddenDrift: exact recreation of an official still
promptDirectives: Preserve smooth translucent dome, extreme leanness and dorsal array in an original pose.

profiles.label: Hive drone phenotype

requiredAnchors.label: Smooth continuous dome
requiredAnchors.requirement: The adult head retains a clean smooth dome without warrior ridges, queen crown or visible eyes.

requiredAnchors.label: Lithe climbing frame
requiredAnchors.requirement: Long grasping digits, flexible hips and shoulders and moderate mass support wall and ceiling locomotion.

promptDirectives: Keep dome, hands, feet and tail legible in a stealth-capable pose.

profiles.label: Ridged hive warrior

requiredAnchors.label: Exposed cranial ridges
requiredAnchors.requirement: Strong longitudinal and cross-linked ridges replace the drone's smooth shell while retaining the elongated eyeless skull.

requiredAnchors.label: Reinforced combat frame
requiredAnchors.requirement: Thicker neck, shoulders, forearms and lower legs add combat mass without turning the creature into a horned fantasy brute.

promptDirectives: Expose ridged cranium and reinforced adult anatomy in silhouette.

profiles.label: Grid-scarred warrior

requiredAnchors.label: Acid-etched head lattice
requiredAnchors.requirement: A permanent intersecting burn lattice deforms the front and crown as healed damage with depth and asymmetry, not painted decoration.

requiredAnchors.label: Scar follows anatomy
requiredAnchors.requirement: The lattice bends over cranial curvature while leaving the underlying ridged warrior construction intact.

promptDirectives: Treat the lattice as old acid damage integrated into a ridged warrior.

profiles.label: Red hive warrior

requiredAnchors.label: Deep crimson carapace
requiredAnchors.requirement: Dark crimson, rust and near-black pigmentation belongs to shell and tissue while preserving wet biomechanical response.

requiredAnchors.label: Physical red pigmentation
requiredAnchors.requirement: Neutral secondary light proves the body is red-pigmented rather than a normal warrior under red lighting.

promptDirectives: Use neutral secondary light so the deep red material is verifiable.

profiles.label: Queen mother

requiredAnchors.label: Monumental layered crown
requiredAnchors.requirement: The queen crown expands into coherent armored layers and rear points without becoming antlers.

requiredAnchors.label: Supreme matriarch scale
requiredAnchors.requirement: Architecture, queens or adult drones establish exceptional scale above a standard queen.

requiredAnchors.label: Brood-command anatomy
requiredAnchors.requirement: Heavy royal torso, secondary arms and crown remain fully functional and readable as one organism.

promptDirectives: Prove exceptional scale with original architecture and subordinate hive forms.

profiles.label: Flying queen

requiredAnchors.label: Functional wing pair
requiredAnchors.requirement: A large bilateral wing pair roots into reinforced thoracic anatomy with believable joints, membrane tension and flight musculature.

requiredAnchors.label: Queen identity in flight
requiredAnchors.requirement: Crown, secondary arms, main arms, hind legs and weapon tail remain separable despite the airborne pose.

promptDirectives: Design wing roots before membrane detail and keep every queen limb count readable.

profiles.label: Gorilla-derived xenomorph

requiredAnchors.label: Eyeless xenomorph cranium
requiredAnchors.requirement: An elongated eyeless dome and inner-jaw mouth remain dominant; no ape muzzle or visible primate eyes.

requiredAnchors.label: Massive forequarters
requiredAnchors.requirement: Extremely long powerful arms, high shoulders and a deep chest support knuckle-assisted movement with coherent hind limbs.

requiredAnchors.label: Biomechanical host adaptation
requiredAnchors.requirement: Host-derived mass modifies ribbed exoskeleton rather than adding fur or ordinary gorilla skin.

requiredAnchors.label: Heavy weapon tail
requiredAnchors.requirement: A long segmented weapon tail counterbalances the forequarters and connects correctly to the pelvis.

promptDirectives: Combine ape-host load distribution with unmistakable xenomorph head, shell and tail.

profiles.label: Bull-derived xenomorph

requiredAnchors.label: Bovine shoulder mass
requiredAnchors.requirement: A deep neck and elevated reinforced shoulders drive a low charging line while remaining organically xenomorph.

requiredAnchors.label: Integrated cranial horn structures
requiredAnchors.requirement: Paired host-derived horn structures grow from the carapace without exposing eyes or replacing the elongated dome.

forbiddenDrift: fur or hooves pasted onto a runner
promptDirectives: Keep the charging quadruped xenomorph-first and integrate horns into the dome.

profiles.label: Mantis-derived xenomorph

requiredAnchors.label: Xenomorph head and jaws
requiredAnchors.requirement: The eyeless elongated head and inner-jaw system remain recognizable and do not become an insect face.

requiredAnchors.label: Raptorial forelimbs
requiredAnchors.requirement: A coherent forelimb pair folds into long scythe-like grasping segments with countable joints and no duplicated arms.

requiredAnchors.label: Angular insectile line
requiredAnchors.requirement: Narrow elevated thorax, long limbs and stalking posture express host influence while retaining a segmented weapon tail.

requiredAnchors.label: Biomechanical surface
requiredAnchors.requirement: Ribbing and tendon channels unify insectile plates instead of depicting an ordinary giant mantis.

promptDirectives: Count every limb and preserve xenomorph cranial and tail identity.

profiles.label: Snake-derived xenomorph

requiredAnchors.label: Continuous serpentine body
requiredAnchors.requirement: An elongated limbless or strongly limb-reduced body transitions continuously into a weaponized terminal tail without a humanoid pelvis.

requiredAnchors.label: Eyeless xenomorph head
requiredAnchors.requirement: A compact elongated dome and inner-jaw construction retain xenomorph identity without snake eyes or reptile muzzle.

requiredAnchors.label: Biomechanical locomotor underside
requiredAnchors.requirement: Ventral segmentation, ribs and musculature plausibly support slithering without ordinary scales.

requiredAnchors.label: Continuous dorsal tendon line
requiredAnchors.requirement: A continuous biomechanical dorsal tendon and rib system links the cranial dome to the terminal tail without a disconnected human torso or ordinary reptile spine.

promptDirectives: Show continuous locomotor anatomy and the xenomorph jaw from an original angle.

profiles.label: Popper volatile xenoid

requiredAnchors.label: Swollen volatile sacs
requiredAnchors.requirement: Distended translucent sacs grow from a coherent torso or dorsal system and visibly contain pressurized corrosive fluid.

requiredAnchors.label: Small rushing profile
requiredAnchors.requirement: Compact scale, low limbs and forward mass create a disposable rushing threat distinct from a full adult runner.

promptDirectives: Connect every volatile sac to plausible anatomy and prove compact scale.

profiles.label: Warden hive guardian

requiredAnchors.label: Forward shield carapace
requiredAnchors.requirement: Head, neck and shoulders interlock into a forward defensive wedge while jaws and sensory orientation remain functional.

requiredAnchors.label: Guardian armor continuity
requiredAnchors.requirement: Dense layered plates follow load paths across chest and forelimbs without becoming manufactured armor.

promptDirectives: Build a biological defensive wedge around intact xenomorph attack anatomy.

profiles.label: Siren sensory xenoid

requiredAnchors.label: Resonant cranial structures
requiredAnchors.requirement: Sensory-resonance structures extend from rear cranium and throat with visible biological roots, never decorative antennae.

requiredAnchors.label: Expanded throat system
requiredAnchors.requirement: Neck, jaw base and thoracic channels form a coherent system for powerful hive calls while preserving the inner jaw.

requiredAnchors.label: Lean signal posture
requiredAnchors.requirement: An elevated neck and braced body make signaling readable without hiding tail or dorsal anatomy.

promptDirectives: Show biological signal anatomy in an original call posture.

profiles.label: Spitter ranged-acid caste

requiredAnchors.label: Integrated acid reservoirs
requiredAnchors.requirement: Paired swollen corrosive reservoirs integrate into the rear jaw, neck and upper torso with visible biological feed channels; they are never floating sacs or external tanks.

requiredAnchors.label: Reinforced spray throat
requiredAnchors.requirement: An expanded muscular throat and widened outer jaw support a directed corrosive spray while preserving the recognizable telescoping inner-jaw system.

requiredAnchors.label: Braced ranged posture
requiredAnchors.requirement: Low hips, planted limbs, elevated neck and a counterbalancing segmented tail create a stable firing line distinct from a charging warrior.

promptDirectives: Make the acid reservoirs, throat and braced silhouette readable together without replacing baseline xenomorph anatomy.

profiles.label: Stalker stealth caste

requiredAnchors.label: Low stealth silhouette
requiredAnchors.requirement: Head, shoulders and hips align into a narrow low contour suited to concealment, without losing the elongated eyeless dome or adult limb plan.

requiredAnchors.label: Shadow-breaking carapace
requiredAnchors.requirement: Subdued dark plates, restrained highlights and fine ribbing break up the outline while remaining physical biomechanical tissue rather than magical invisibility.

requiredAnchors.label: Wall-ready grasping anatomy
requiredAnchors.requirement: Long countable digits, flexed shoulders and coherent feet support silent wall or ceiling locomotion; no fused claws or spider-like extra limbs.

promptDirectives: Reveal the complete stalking anatomy through controlled rim light while preserving a low concealment silhouette.

profiles.label: Scorched station-born adult

requiredAnchors.label: Localized scorched cranial scar
requiredAnchors.requirement: One unmistakable asymmetric cauterized injury interrupts the long cranial carapace with cracked, heat-discolored tissue; damage is localized and structurally healed rather than generic flames over the whole body.

requiredAnchors.label: Long practical-effect cranium
requiredAnchors.requirement: A long eyeless adult dome retains restrained underlying biomechanical structure and a credible jaw axis, never collapsing into a short monster skull.

requiredAnchors.label: Tall lean station-hunter frame
requiredAnchors.requirement: A tall narrow waist, long load-bearing limbs and grounded wall-crawling articulation preserve the imposing adult scale without exaggerated superhero mass.

promptDirectives: Keep the localized cranial damage readable from an original angle while preserving the complete adult body plan.
